How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?

Standard shipping takes 1-3 business days for us to fulfill your order, plus 4-8 business days for delivery—so you can expect your order to arrive within 5-11 business days total. Most orders arrive on the quicker side of that window, but we give the full range just in case. If you want more details, you can check out our full shipping info here: Shipping Information.

What's your return and refund policy?

Our return and refund policy is designed to be simple and stress-free:

Most unused, non-defective items can be returned for a full refund within 90 days of purchase.
Items need to be unused and in their original packaging.
Personalized or custom items, and orders shipped to Canada, aren’t eligible for returns.
If you return an item, the cost of return shipping will be deducted from your refund.
We don’t offer direct exchanges, but you’re welcome to return and place a new order if you’d like.

You can check out all the details or start a return here: Return & Refund Policy.

items?

We offer a Limited Lifetime Warranty for our products! If your item has a manufacturing defect—like a broken lid, insulation failure, or damage upon arrival—we’ll make it right. Just keep in mind, the warranty doesn’t cover normal wear and tear, drops, or issues from improper use or cleaning.
